Chapter 6567: Horrified

Chapter 6567: Horrified

“Ahh!” Xian Chengtian’s scream echoed throughout the abyss.

His dao harmony, three ribbons, and Immortal Killer couldn’t save him from the boundless dark desire.

Given his background, his mind was massive and filled with immortal light. However, the dark desire filled it up and destroyed his true fate. Desire was a dreadful force since it existed alongside life. Chengtian was caught unprepared because his own desires erupted in resonance with the invader.

They multiplied endlessly and caused him to fall into the darkness, destroying his grand dao and laws.

“Ahh!” He screamed while being immobilized by the abyss. More and more desires from the source rushed in.

This took a long time until he was broken down.

“It’s over for Xian Chengtian.” One overlord murmured after seeing the destruction of the true fate.

“Am I still inferior to you?” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost held Chengtian’s temples firmly and roared: “Show me how your superiority and your immortal disposition!”

The merciless invasion gave him an unprecedented feeling of happiness. He finally obliterated his opponent and nothing could feel better.

“Where is your perfect dao harmony? Show it to me!” His face became twisted.

A trauma was embedded when he showed his ugliest side to Chengtian who was perfect. This profound feeling of inferiority turned into hatred and jealousy.

Now, he finally did it while looking at the guy’s flawless face and shouting: “Open your dog eyes, see who the real winner is!”

Alas, Chengtian’s mind was broken so he couldn’t respond.

“Ahh!” The ghost finished him using the dark desire, leaving the spectators speechless.

He wasn’t satiated. If he could revive Chengtian, he would do so again and again to repeat this process - just slower the next time.

“His plan backfired.” An overlord sighed.

Xian Chengtian was unkillable without the involvement of an immortal. However, his pride and arrogance were his downfall, heading into a clear trap.

Others thought Chengtian was brilliant and had competed against immortals before. His end was unexpected.

Although they didn’t know the secretive past between the two, it seemed Chengtian had saved Primal Yin Immortal Ghost. This turned out to be a deadly mistake.

“Really knows how to put on a show.” Li Qiye couldn’t help but smile.

Xian Chengtian and Primal Yin Immortal Ghost had no idea. Both thought they would be the last man smiling.

“Pop!” Suddenly, the eye of desires behind the ghost shattered.

The abyss became unstable and broke down. Remember, even Immortal Killer couldn’t pierce through it.

Of course, it didn’t break for no reason. Someone else entered the abyss, instantly making it to the end where Primordial Gate awaited.

“An immortal.” Everyone could tell after sensing the abyss’ collapse. This was beyond the work of any overlord.

“Desolate Ancestor!” The ghost sensed her energy and was horrified.

His excitement and joy dispersed while cold chills took over. He immediately fled as fast and as far as he possibly could, just wanting to hide from this cultivator.
